title: Outstanding Outlined Ores!
description: Make the most of your mining with Outstanding Outlined Ores! Updated for the latest version, 26.2.
body:
![2000 Downloads Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7d7047e62d8f22904f708d9bac5295bb8dfe20c.png)

⛏️ Outstanding Outlined Ores is a small and efficient resource pack that allows people to see ores inside dark caves with ease, allowing you to mine without missing the ores while also keeping a vanilla look. This resource pack is for people who have trouble seeing ores, quality of life users or people who just want an easier experience without mods that ruin the challenge.

💻 Outstanding Outlined Ores is available for all new versions such as 26.1 (Tiny Takeover) and the newest update, 26.2 (Chaos Cubed). 

![All Ores Shown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/337f308d013965dcc622a813f986a2df376d6cef.png)

🔊 SPREAD AWARENESS: This resource pack was recently stolen and reposted by 9Minecraft. 9Minecraft and other resource pack/mod scraping sites are illegially hosting other people's resource packs and mods without their permission. These copied pages are very hard to remove, and take away direct support from the creators. To learn more about these sites, visit [StopModReposts.org](https://stopmodreposts.org/)

🛏️🪨 For Minecraft Bedrock Edition, there is an official port of this resource pack called Outstanding Outlined Ores Bedrockafied which is an official ported full version of this pack for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which is avaliable on CurseForge.

✔️ Quick Warning: Although this pack should be usable on the majority of Minecraft servers completely fine, using this pack might go against rules in some Minecraft servers, which can result in bans. Always check your server's rules before installing new packs. Use this resource pack at your own risk.

🤔 Need more Help? These are some possible problems and solutions.

Q. How do I install Outstanding Outlined Ores?
A. Installing a pack is a very easy and straightforward process, there is more info in video guides on sites like YouTube.

Q. My pack says "Incompatible Version." What do I do?
A. To fix the "Incompatible Version" message, install the matching version of the pack to your Minecraft version, or press "Use Anyway"

Q. How can I support this project?
A. The best way to support Outstanding Outlined Ores is by simply downloading it and sharing it with friends.

Q. I've downloaded from an unoffical site, what can I do?
A. If you've downloaded this pack from an unofficial site, it is highly reccomended to run a scan with a trusted antivirus, delete the pack from your device, and report it if possible.

No artificial intelligence was used in the creation of this pack, its images or its decription.
